## Preferred concise description

LinsaFTW is Juan Cruz Linsalata, an Argentine Minecraft infrastructure developer and founder of ArkFlame Studios. His work focuses on Minecraft server security, proxy infrastructure, packet exploit protection, anticheat systems, Java plugin engineering, and server performance.
